title: Dakota Johnson sells renovated LA ‘tree house’ for $5.92M after buying it for $3.55M
summary_full: Dakota Johnson has successfully sold her stunning Los Angeles residence for an impressive $5,924,372, having owned the property since 2016. Initially purchased for $3.55 million amid her burgeoning career, the midcentury home underwent extensive renovations to elevate its charm. Listed at $6 million, it quickly found a buyer, closing a notable chapter in the actress's life.
